claim.quote: A time alignment of about 120 ps and a time resolution around 615 ps have been achieved. Concerning the energy, an alignment of 7.5% has been obtained.

date.note: arXiv v1 date; published in JINST (2025).

key_value_text.quote: A time alignment of about 120 ps and a time resolution around 615 ps have been achieved.
key_value_text.value: time alignment ~120 ps; time resolution ~615 ps; energy alignment 7.5 %

name: Calorimeter commissioning of the SuperNEMO Demonstrator

summary.plain: The 712-block scintillator calorimeter of the SuperNEMO Demonstrator was built underground and calibrated with gamma rays. Its timing is aligned to about 120 picoseconds and its energy scale to 7.5 per cent, before the tracker is added.
summary.technical: First time and energy calibration of the Demonstrator calorimeter with gamma rays from calibration sources and ambient radioactivity: time alignment ~120 ps, time resolution ~615 ps, energy alignment 7.5 %; to be improved when electrons from calibration sources are added.

title: Calorimeter commissioning of the SuperNEMO Demonstrator
why_it_matters: A step towards the first physics data of the SuperNEMO Demonstrator; no physics result has been published yet.
